ref.quote: The 300 cap is not new. The portal has had it since 2025: manual upload, SVG upload and the zip bulk upload. Admins can raise it per merchant. The Open API applies the same check, only when adding a clipart.

The 300 cap is not new. The portal has had it since 2025: manual upload, SVG upload and the zip bulk upload. Admins can raise it per merchant. The Open API applies the same check, only when adding a clipart.

legs.statement_basis: Cap 300 có từ 2025 ở manual upload, SVG upload, zip bulk; admin nâng được theo merchant; Open API áp cùng kiểm tra, chỉ khi thêm clipart.

ref.quote: POST /cliparts: 422 on category_id with the portal's message: "The category allows up to 5 items". It's checked before the file is read, so the upload_id isn't used up and nothing counts toward the daily limit. on_duplicate: replace still works on a full category because it adds nothing.

legs.statement_basis: POST /cliparts chạm cap: 422 trên category_id, message của portal dạng "The category allows up to <cap> items". Số 5 trong quote là cap thử nghiệm, không phải giá trị mặc định.

ref.quote: Zip bulk upload: it always creates new categories from the zip's folders (optionally under parent_category_id); it can't upload into an existing category. The cap applies to each new category, so it can be tested with one folder holding more files than the cap. The upload is accepted, the extra files are skipped, each with a line in logs like Failed - <path> - The category allows up to 5 items, and the bulk upload ends as done.

legs.statement_basis: Zip bulk luôn tạo category mới từ folder; cap áp cho từng category mới; file thừa bị skip, mỗi file một dòng log Failed; bulk upload kết thúc done.

ref.quote: The cap can be set in admin panel at /admin/users/{id}/edit: Admin → Users → edit user 64 → "Config". Add "clipart_max_per_category": 5 to the existing JSON

legs.statement_basis: Cap chỉnh theo user ở Admin > Users > edit user > Config, key clipart_max_per_category trong JSON có sẵn. Đi vào entry_points[].precondition của profile.

statement_limits: Không ghi id user, giá trị thử nghiệm của cap, tên account.
Số 300 là số tại thời điểm nguồn (CCR 4.2).
